_comment: Rooman Billing's OWN subscription plans (what organizations buy from Rooman) - unrelated to tenant Plan rows, which are a tenant's plans for its customers. Backend source of truth, validated by backend/app/core/plan_catalog.py against core/modules.json. Prices are integers in the currency's smallest unit (paise). A plan is offered only when status is 'published', which also requires tax_treatment and approval to be recorded. Status 'sandbox' marks a TEST-ONLY plan (reserved 'sandbox_' code, 'Sandbox' name, tiny amount, no tax treatment, never approved): it is never listed publicly and can be bought only in a local environment with PLATFORM_SANDBOX_PLANS_ENABLED and Razorpay Test Mode keys. Nothing here grants modules to any organization.

bundles.label: Foundation
bundles.description: Customers, catalog, GST invoices, credit notes, payments, quotes, standard reports and your own Razorpay / SMTP connections.

bundles.label: Service Operations
bundles.description: Run a service business: customer portal and hosted payment pages, collections, payment matching, expenses, projects and timesheets.

bundles.label: Recurring Revenue
bundles.description: Recurring billing: subscriptions, trials, usage and proration, failed-payment recovery, customer lifecycle and automation.

dunning.reason: Dunning cases are opened automatically only for failed subscription-invoice payments (api/v1/endpoints/webhooks.py).

not_offered.ai_billing: Deterministic keyword assistant, not a general AI model; not sold as a feature.
not_offered.platforms: Device registry only; no native mobile or desktop apps exist.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: GST-ready invoicing, quotes and payments for small teams.

plans.name: Growth
plans.description: Everything in Starter plus the tools to run a service business.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: Everything in Growth plus recurring billing and payment recovery.

plans.name: Sandbox Test Plan (Foundation)
plans.description: TEST MODE ONLY - not a commercial offer. Grants only the Foundation bundle so a Razorpay Test Mode purchase can be checked end to end.
